pages.title: Nile Crocodile
pages.text: The Nile crocodile ($(o)Crocodylus niloticus$()) lives in the rivers, lakes and swamps of Africa.$(br2)It is an ambush hunter that waits for wildebeest, zebras and antelope crossing rivers, then drags its prey under with a spinning death roll.$(br2)Nile crocodiles often bask together on sandbanks with their mouths open to cool down.
